datevKey - DATEV account assignment key for standard rate transactions

vatKey - Internal VAT identification code (e.g., "V19")
vatKeyDescription - Human-readable description of the VAT type (e.g., "Vorsteuer 5,5%" for 5.5% input tax)
vatCode - Geographic scope of the VAT rule (e.g., "Inland" for domestic transactions)
purchaseAccount - General ledger account number for purchase transactions
salesAccount - General ledger account number for sales transactions
salesNotDueAccount - General ledger account for sales not yet due (nullable)
cashDiscountAccount - General ledger account number for cash discount handling

Multiple VAT entries can be provided.
